<p>Hello 大家好😁。</p>
<p>如果你在 2026 年，还在用 <code>JavaScript</code> 监听滚动事件来实现视差动画，还在用 <code>ResizeObserver</code> 来做组件级响应式，还在引入 <code>Popper.js</code> 来定位一个小小的气泡提示框……</p>
<p>那你欠浏览器一句道歉😀。</p>
<p>过去两年，<code>CSS</code> 在底层经历了一场极其猛烈的能力跃迁。大量曾经必须依赖 <code>JavaScript</code> 才能实现的交互和布局逻辑，现在只需要一行 <code>CSS</code> 声明就能搞定。而且由于这些能力直接运行在浏览器的渲染引擎底层，它们的性能表现，是任何 <code>JavaScript</code> 方案都无法比拟的。</p>
<p>以下是我整理出来的 6 个在 2026 年已经获得主流浏览器全面支持，但依然被国内大量前端严重低估的纯 <code>CSS</code> 新特性👇。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-0"><code>:has()</code> 选择器 —— 让父元素感知子元素</h3>
<p>在 <code>CSS</code> 长达 20 多年的历史里，有一个让所有前端痛彻心扉的缺陷：<strong>你永远无法根据子元素的状态，去反向控制父元素的样式。</strong></p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b62828320166401d9baf8c1d7adac4d7~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=EvXKjiCJiOwA%2FfRpPUkBR6CY3GE%3D" alt="ChatGPT Image 2026年8月24日 10_42_02.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>比如一个极其常见的表单场景：当输入框获得焦点时，让它的外层容器高亮。过去你必须用 <code>JavaScript</code> 监听 <code>focus</code> 和 <code>blur</code> 事件，手动给父元素切换 <code>class</code>。</p>
<p><strong>JavaScript 手动监听</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 为了让父容器感知子元素的焦点状态，被迫写一坨事件监听🤷‍♂️</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> input = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.form-input'</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wrapper = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.form-wrapper'</span>);

input.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'focus'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  wrapper.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'is-focused'</span>);
});


input.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'blur'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  wrapper.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">remove</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'is-focused'</span>);
});
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.form-wrapper</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.is-focused</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">border-color</span>: <span class="hljs-number">#3b82f6</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">box-shadow</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">3px</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">rgba</span>(<span class="hljs-number">59</span>, <span class="hljs-number">130</span>, <span class="hljs-number">246</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>现在是一行 CSS 直接秒杀⚡</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-comment">/* 父元素直接感知内部 input 的焦点状态，零 JavaScript */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.form-wrapper</span><span class="hljs-selector-pseudo">:has</span>(<span class="hljs-selector-tag">input</span><span class="hljs-selector-pseudo">:focus</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">border-color</span>: <span class="hljs-number">#3b82f6</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">box-shadow</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span> <span class="hljs-number">3px</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">rgba</span>(<span class="hljs-number">59</span>, <span class="hljs-number">130</span>, <span class="hljs-number">246</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>:has()</code> 选择器的威力远不止如此。你可以用 <code>.card:has(img)</code> 来区分有图和无图的卡片布局；用 <code>form:has(:invalid)</code> 来在表单存在校验错误时，直接禁用提交按钮的视觉样式；甚至用 <code>body:has(.modal-open)</code> 来在弹窗打开时锁定背景滚动。</p>
<p>这一个选择器，干掉了过去无数的状态切换 <code>JavaScript</code>。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-1"><code>@container</code> 容器查询</h3>
<p>传统的 <code>@media</code> 媒体查询，响应的是<strong>整个视口</strong>的宽度。但在组件化开发的时代，同一个卡片组件可能被放在宽度 300px 的侧边栏里，也可能被放在宽度 800px 的主内容区里。视口宽度根本不能反映组件自身的实际空间。</p>
<p>过去为了实现组件级响应式，你不得不引入 <code>ResizeObserver</code>，写一大段 <code>JavaScript</code> 去监听容器尺寸变化，然后手动切换布局。</p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d7070f1d1c234bc5b54b3e14eadb8fb0~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=DvrNu%2Fn40FojpiJx1bFEUxEtqPM%3D" alt="ahmad-feature-images-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>ResizeObserver 的手动监听</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 为了让卡片组件根据自身容器宽度切换布局，被迫引入 JS 观察者</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">entries</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> entries) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = entry.<span class="hljs-property">contentRect</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (width &lt; <span class="hljs-number">400</span>) {
      entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'compact'</span>);
      entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">remove</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'wide'</span>);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'wide'</span>);
      entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">remove</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'compact'</span>);
    }
  }
});

observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.card-container'</span>));
</code></pre>
<p><strong>纯 CSS 容器查询</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-comment">/* 声明容器 */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.card-container</span> {
  container-type: inline-size;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/* 组件根据自身容器的宽度自动切换布局，零 JavaScript */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.card</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: grid;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">grid-template-columns</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>fr;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">@container</span> (<span class="hljs-attribute">min-width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">400px</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-selector-class">.card</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attribute">grid-template-columns</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200px</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>fr;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>组件不再需要关心自己被放在了页面的哪个位置，它会根据自身的物理空间自动适配布局。这是 <code>CSS</code> 有史以来最接近智能组件的能力跃迁。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">滚动驱动动画 —— 彻底干掉 scroll 事件监听</h3>
<p>过去，凡是和滚动相关的动画效果（进度条、视差、淡入淡出），你都必须监听 <code>scroll</code> 事件。而 <code>scroll</code> 事件是浏览器中触发频率最高的事件之一，处理不好极其容易导致主线程卡顿和掉帧。</p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/5fdce9b8581e446f979b484405ebbe01~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=44MDipHjVY1rvMMkfAksDEqLwQ8%3D" alt="20260824113323_rec_-convert.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>JavaScript 监听滚动</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 为了实现一个顶部阅读进度条，被迫疯狂监听 scroll 事件</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scrollTop = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">documentElement</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTop</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scrollHeight = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">documentElement</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollHeight</span> - <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">innerHeight</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> progress = (scrollTop / scrollHeight) * <span class="hljs-number">100</span>;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.progress-bar'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${progress}</span>%`</span>;
});
</code></pre>
<p>这段代码在用户快速滚动时，每秒会触发几十次甚至上百次回调，直接榨干主线程的算力。</p>
<p><strong>现在是纯 CSS 滚动驱动动画</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-comment">/* 顶部阅读进度条，完全由浏览器渲染引擎在合成层驱动，零 JS 零卡顿 */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.progress-bar</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">position</span>: fixed;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">top</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">left</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3px</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-number">#3b82f6</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0%</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/* 绑定到页面的滚动进度，浏览器底层自动计算 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-attribute">animation</span>: grow-progress linear;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">animation</span>-timeline: <span class="hljs-built_in">scroll</span>();
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">@keyframes</span> grow-progress {
  <span class="hljs-selector-tag">from</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0%</span>; }
  <span class="hljs-selector-tag">to</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100%</span>; }
}
</code></pre>
<p>整个动画被完全交给了浏览器底层的<strong>合成线程（Compositor Thread）</strong> 去驱动，根本不会占用主线程的一丝算力。这种性能差距，不是优化几行 <code>JavaScript</code> 能弥补的，是架构层面的降维打击。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3"><code>@starting-style</code> —— 原生实现 <code>display: none</code> 的入场动画</h3>
<p>这个特性解决了一个困扰前端十几年的深水区痛点：<strong>你无法对 <code>display: none</code> 到 <code>display: block</code> 的切换做过渡动画。</strong></p>
<p>过去，为了实现一个弹窗的淡入效果，你要么引入 <code>Framer Motion</code> 这种动画库，要么用 <code>JavaScript</code> 先把元素设为 <code>display: block</code>，然后在下一帧再切换 <code>opacity</code>，极其丑陋。</p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/77a7fa1c552649d4beba64b3b5437ad1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=5GeqrtW1oLekZm%2FfJrg64yBCkno%3D" alt="20260824111532_rec_.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>JavaScript 双帧 Hack</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 为了让弹窗从 display:none 淡入，被迫写出这种恶心的双帧 hack</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">showModal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">el</span>) {
  el.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">display</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'block'</span>;
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 强制浏览器重排，否则 transition 不会触发</span>
  el.<span class="hljs-property">offsetHeight</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 这行看起来毫无意义，但删掉动画就失效</span>
  el.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visible'</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>纯 CSS 原生入场动画</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.modal</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: none;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">transition</span>: opacity <span class="hljs-number">0.3s</span> ease, display <span class="hljs-number">0.3s</span> ease allow-discrete;
}

<span class="hljs-selector-class">.modal</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.open</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: block;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/* 告诉浏览器：从 display:none 切换过来时，opacity 从 0 开始 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">@starting-style</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attribute">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>浏览器原生支持了离散属性（如 <code>display</code>）的过渡动画。不需要任何 <code>JavaScript</code>，不需要任何动画库，一个弹窗的淡入淡出就被几行 <code>CSS</code> 完美解决了🤷‍♂️。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-4"><code>field-sizing: content</code>——自动撑高的 textarea</h3>
<p>过去，为了让一个多行输入框根据内容自动调整高度（而不是固定一个死板的高度），你需要用 <code>JavaScript</code> 去监听 <code>input</code> 事件，动态计算 <code>scrollHeight</code> 并赋值给 <code>style.height</code>。</p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/02160bc074be48778ae4f9eb20c5297b~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=%2BeTIVGvdRdTZoNN9H%2BWGz2juAJg%3D" alt="20260824110953_rec_-convert.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>JavaScript 手动撑高</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> textarea = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'textarea'</span>);
textarea.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  textarea.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'auto'</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 先重置，否则只会越来越高</span>
  textarea.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = textarea.<span class="hljs-property">scrollHeight</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
});
</code></pre>
<p><strong>现在是一行 CSS</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-tag">textarea</span> {
  field-sizing: content; <span class="hljs-comment">/* 浏览器根据内容自动撑高，零 JavaScript */</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>一行 <code>CSS</code>，干掉了一个在前端圈流传了十几年的经典 <code>JavaScript</code> Hack 🖐️。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-5"><code>CSS Anchor Positioning</code> —— 原生的气泡定位</h3>
<p>过去，只要你需要实现一个 <strong>点击按钮弹出气泡提示框，且气泡自动贴在按钮旁边</strong> 的效果，你几乎必须引入 <code>Popper.js</code> 或 <code>Floating UI</code> 这种定位库。因为手动计算位置、处理边界溢出翻转，这套逻辑的复杂度极高。</p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/93cb1b9e551a47e09e05e00a589db5b2~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788149028&amp;x-signature=Qzvmr%2BKbglcgwKCoapBme2vo5iY%3D" alt="20260824111256_rec_.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>用 CSS 原生锚点定位</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-comment">/* 声明锚点 */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.trigger-button</span> {
  anchor-name: --my-anchor;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/* 气泡自动定位到锚点下方，溢出时自动翻转 */</span>
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tooltip</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attribute">position</span>: fixed;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">position</span>-anchor: --my-anchor;
  <span class="hljs-attribute">top</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">anchor</span>(bottom);
  <span class="hljs-attribute">left</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">anchor</span>(center);

  <span class="hljs-comment">/* 原生的溢出翻转逻辑，浏览器自动处理 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-attribute">position</span>-try-fallbacks: flip-block, flip-inline;
}
</code></pre>
<p>不需要任何 <code>JavaScript</code> 库，不需要计算 <code>getBoundingClientRect</code>，不需要处理滚动偏移。浏览器的渲染引擎直接在布局阶段帮你搞定一切，包括边界检测和自动翻转。这意味着你可以从项目的依赖里删掉一整个定位库🙌。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">要知道什么时候不写 JavaScript</h3>
<p><code>CSS</code> 的这一轮能力爆发，本质上是浏览器厂商在把越来越多的<strong>交互决策权</strong>从 <code>JavaScript</code> 主线程，下沉到了渲染引擎的底层。</p>
<p>这不仅仅是少写几行代码的问题。每一行被 <code>CSS</code> 替换掉的 <code>JavaScript</code>，都意味着主线程少了一份负担，页面的渲染帧率高了一个台阶，用户的交互响应快了几毫秒。</p>
<p>今天写到这里，喜欢点赞收藏🙏</p>
